You will be responsible for operating a forklift to transport and move berries throughout the farm and, in the cool room, you will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining the temperature and humidity levels, operating and maintaining the cooling equipment, and following safety regulations and quality control standards. The role's purpose is to contribute to the efficient and effective operation of the berry farm and its reputation as a supplier of high-quality berries. In this role, it is imperative that you be more than just a berry transporter. You must be a real team player and be willing to help with other tasks at the trailers such as stacking the pallets and quality checking the berries.

-	Operate a forklift to transport pallets throughout the farm

-	Move pallets to and from storage areas

-	Report any equipment malfunctions or safety concerns to the supervisor

-	Ensure fruits are correctly placed onto the cooling mechanism and correctly labelled.
-	Keep accurate records and paperwork for delivery to Driscoll.

-	Ensure that the harvested berries are stored correctly in the cool room according to the specific requirements.
-	Operate and maintain the cooling systems and equipment in the cool room to ensure that they are functioning properly.
-	Communicate with the Truck Driver to coordinate the daily shipment of berries from the cool room to the customers.
-	Keep accurate records of the temperature and humidity levels in the cool room and any other relevant information.
-	Follow all safety regulations and quality control standards to ensure that the harvested berries meet the required specifications.
-	Assist the trailer team with other duties such as quality checking and pallet organisation as required
-	Perform other related duties as assigned by the Farm Manager.

-	Ability to work autonomously.
-	Excellent communication and leadership skills.
-	Attention to detail.
-	Basic computer skills desirable.
-	Willingness to work in a cold environment
-	Willingness to obtain forklift license
